headline: Subshell 1.0.4: polls that stay open, clearer mod queue reasons and a sturdier Wiki
highlights: Reading: "Open on Reddit to vote" on a poll opens it in your browser and keeps it there, also when you sign in on the way. Subshell's links come back when you return.
Inbox: the ⋮ menu on a chat message stays open while the keyboard is up.
Moderation: mod queue cards name why an item is held, read from the mod log: "Held by AutoModerator: <the rule's reason>" or "Held by Reddit's filters: <reason>".
Moderation: an item removed by a named moderator or app says who removed it and is not called a filter hold, and a card's age shows before a long user flair.
Moderation: Back steps out of a mod tool and the community Wiki one step at a time, and the Mod tab comes back on its own after a failed check.
Wiki: a page or wiki that only exists in Reddit's new Wiki says so and offers Open on reddit.com, and config pages such as AutoModerator's read as plain text.
Behind the scenes: the app's text is ready for translation. This release is still in English only.
If something does not work for you, tell us on r/subshell or GitHub.
